data.body:
RCA (Phase 1 complete) — CONFIRMED, mechanism proven at runtime.

ROOT CAUSE. `tests/unit/rebar_reconciler/test_dc_transport_pagination_heldout.py:31-34`
binds `_TRANSPORT_SRC` to a single hardcoded path,
`src/rebar/_engine/rebar_reconciler/adapters/jira_datacenter/transport.py`. The guard
`test_no_search_issues_call_relies_on_the_default_page_size` calls
`_search_issues_calls_taking_the_default()` with no `src`, which `ast.parse()`s exactly that
one file and returns the offending call list. Commit 4213081d23 ("Split DC transport into
capability mixins", rebar-ticket 465d-c541-5e52-4e62) relocated every `search_issues` call
out of `transport.py` into the mixins. Its own message says "Pure text move: no test edited"
— that is precisely the defect: the hardcoded scan path was not moved with the code, so the
guard's population went to zero and `assert not offenders` became unconditionally true.

DISCRIMINATING EVIDENCE.
1. Before/after AST count on the split commit itself (this is the experiment that
   distinguishes "guard rotted by the split" from every rival — a renamed keyword, a broken
   predicate, or an offender that simply does not exist):
     git show 4213081d23^:.../transport.py | grep -n search_issues
       -> line 365 `self._client.search_issues(jql, startAt=..., maxResults=max_results)`
       -> line 406 `self._client.search_issues(jql, startAt=offset, maxResults=page_size, ...)`
     AST walk of transport.py at HEAD -> 0 `search_issues` ast.Call nodes.
   The predicate is intact; its INPUT is empty. Rivals rejected.
2. Runtime observation of the live guard predicate (not a source read):
     PYTHONPATH=src/rebar/_engine:tests python -c "from unit...test_dc_transport_pagination_heldout
       import _search_issues_calls_taking_the_default as P; print(P())"
     -> scanned: transport.py  exists: True
     -> LIVE GUARD PREDICATE RETURNS: []
   The assertion runs on an empty list. The teeth test still passes because it feeds the
   predicate a synthetic `src=` string, so the predicate's correctness masks the fact that
   nothing real is being scanned.
3. Full-directory AST census of the DC adapter at HEAD (the guard's intended population):
     _base.py:172   kwargs={startAt, maxResults, fields}  capped=True
     _issues.py:262 kwargs={startAt, maxResults}          capped=True
     all other modules (transport, _links, _people, _hierarchy, backend, retry, settings,
       transitions, __init__): 0 calls
   Confirms the ticket's pre-check: widening the scan goes green immediately, so this is a
   pure guard-scope repair with no runtime behaviour change.

LEGITIMACY: defect. The violated contract is stated in-repo, not merely by the reporter —
the guard's own docstring ("THE CRITERION THAT CONVERTS 'I fixed two' INTO 'a fourth cannot
be added silently'") and its sibling's ("A structural test that cannot fail is decoration").
A guard that cannot fail no longer meets its own documented invariant.

CALLER-DEPENDENCY SWEEP: `_search_issues_calls_taking_the_default` is module-private with
exactly two callers, both in this same test file (the guard and its teeth test). Blast radius
is confined to one test module; nothing depends on the narrow scan.

FIX PLAN (mechanical, scope-only):
1. Replace `_TRANSPORT_SRC` (single file) with `_DC_ADAPTER_DIR` and have the predicate walk
   every `*.py` under `adapters/jira_datacenter/`, reporting offenders as `<module>:<line>`
   so the failure message names the file. Keep the `src=` override so the existing teeth test
   is unchanged in intent.
2. Add a NON-VACUITY guard: assert the widened scan actually observes a non-zero number of
   `search_issues` call sites. This is the anti-rot fix proper — a future move that empties
   the directory turns the suite RED instead of silently disarming it.
3. Add a teeth test proving the widened predicate reports a synthetic uncapped call attributed
   to a NON-transport.py module.
No src/ change; no pagination behaviour touched.
